proposed.text: Why is daylighting an envelope issue as well as a lighting issue?

options.text: Glazing has no effect on cooling load.
Larger glazing can admit more heat, so the envelope must control solar gains while allowing useful daylight.
Daylighting eliminates the need for window design.
